capabilities: Expose git, GitHub and Bitbucket tools to AI agents
Keep development project history in notes
disambiguation: Not a git-sync plugin for vault backup; it provides git tools for AI agents working on development projects.
extras: Version 0.1.0, under development; the README says the tools themselves are added in later phases, so the current release may have limited functionality.
problem: AI agents in Obsidian have no built-in access to git, GitHub or Bitbucket operations or to a project's development history.

relations.evidence: Requires the AI Ecosystem plugin (installed and enabled).

summary: Git toolkit that exposes git, GitHub and Bitbucket tools to AI agents and keeps each project's development history in notes.
